name: Aggressive Biomancy
oracle_text: Create X tokens that are copies of target creature you control, except they have "When this token enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control."
blocked_sentences: Create X tokens that are copies of target creature you control, except they have "When this token enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control."

needs.what: copy_permanent's `except_` adding a whole quoted triggered ability to the token copies' copiable values (707.9b) -- here "When this token enters, it fights up to one target creature you don't control" (a self-enters trigger whose effect is `fight` between the token and an optional target creature an opponent controls) -- present as the tokens enter so the enters trigger fires for each of the X copies, and copied along by any later copy of a token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: copy_permanent's `except_` is checked against COPY_EXCEPT_KEYS (add_keywords, colors, types, power, toughness, add_types, add_subtypes, add_supertypes, remove_supertypes, no_mana_cost) and becomes `copy_overrides`, which characteristics reads only for those characteristics; nothing adds a triggered ability. A following `grant_ability` on the copies' `as` binding comes after they entered, so a 'when this token enters' trigger would never fire, and it is a layer-6 grant rather than a copiable value. Resolving `fight` directly in the spell via for_each over the binding skips the trigger (targets chosen on the stack, can be responded to) and is an approximation. The rest -- X from {X}{X}, target creature you control, copy_permanent amount X, fight with up to one target -- is expressible.
